whatsapp.metaDescription: Turn WhatsApp into your 24/7 booking assistant. Let customers book appointments, ask questions, and get support directly through WhatsApp.
whatsapp.headline: Turn WhatsApp Into Your 24/7 Booking Assistant
whatsapp.subheadline: Let customers book, reschedule, and ask questions directly through WhatsApp. Your AI assistant handles conversations around the clock.
whatsapp.benefitsSubtitle: Meet your customers where they already spend their time
whatsapp.benefit1Desc: Never miss a booking. Your AI assistant responds instantly at any hour, in any timezone.
whatsapp.benefit2Desc: Customers book through natural chat. No apps to download, no forms to fill.
whatsapp.benefit3Desc: Reduce no-shows with automated appointment reminders sent directly to WhatsApp.
whatsapp.benefit4Desc: WhatsApp has 2+ billion users worldwide. Your business is now accessible to all of them.
whatsapp.howItWorksSubtitle: From message to confirmed booking in minutes
whatsapp.step1Desc: Customer texts your WhatsApp Business number asking about availability or services.
whatsapp.step2Desc: Your AI assistant responds naturally, answers questions, and guides them through booking.
whatsapp.step3Desc: Customer picks a time slot and confirms. The booking appears in your dashboard instantly.
whatsapp.step4Desc: Both you and the customer receive confirmation. Reminders are sent automatically before the appointment.
whatsapp.useCasesSubtitle: See how businesses like yours use WhatsApp booking
whatsapp.perfectFor: Perfect for: Salons, Clinics, Consultants, Fitness Studios, and more
whatsapp.useCase1Desc: Clients book their next appointment while waiting in line at the grocery store.
whatsapp.useCase1Example: Client texts at midnight, books a 9am slot for tomorrow
whatsapp.useCase2Desc: Patients reschedule appointments without waiting on hold.
whatsapp.useCase2Example: Patient reschedules their checkup in 30 seconds via chat
whatsapp.useCase3Desc: International clients book in their timezone without confusion.
whatsapp.useCase3Example: Client in Tokyo books a call with consultant in London
whatsapp.pricingSubtitle: WhatsApp integration is part of the AI Chatbot add-on for Pro plans
whatsapp.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about WhatsApp integration
whatsapp.faq1Q: Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?
whatsapp.faq1A: Yes, you'll need a WhatsApp Business account and access to the WhatsApp Business API. We provide step-by-step setup instructions to help you get started.
whatsapp.faq2A: Absolutely! WhatsApp is just one channel. Customers can also book through your website widget or directly on your booking page.
whatsapp.faq3Q: Is there a limit on WhatsApp messages?
whatsapp.faq3A: WhatsApp conversations use tokens from your monthly allowance. Most conversations use 1,000-3,000 tokens, so you can handle hundreds of bookings per month.
whatsapp.faq4Q: Can I customize the AI's responses?
whatsapp.faq4A: Yes! You can set the AI's personality, greeting message, and add your own knowledge base documents to train it about your specific services.
whatsapp.faq5A: Your AI assistant works 24/7. It can take bookings at any time and inform customers about your working hours if they try to book during closed times.
whatsapp.finalCtaSubtitle: Join thousands of businesses already using BookBot

chatbot.metaDescription: Embed an intelligent AI chatbot on your website. Answer questions, book appointments, and provide 24/7 support automatically.
chatbot.headline: Your Website Visitor's Personal Booking Concierge
chatbot.subheadline: An intelligent chatbot that answers questions, books appointments, and provides support - all without human intervention.
chatbot.benefitsSubtitle: Turn visitors into customers while you sleep
chatbot.benefit1Desc: Add the chatbot to any website with a simple copy-paste embed code. No technical skills required.
chatbot.benefit2Desc: The widget automatically adapts to your brand colors. Customize position, greeting, and appearance.
chatbot.benefit3Desc: Train the AI with your FAQs, services, and policies. It answers questions accurately using your content.
chatbot.benefit4Desc: Visitors can complete the entire booking flow through natural conversation. No forms needed.
chatbot.howItWorksSubtitle: From installation to first booking in minutes
chatbot.step1Desc: Get your unique embed code from the settings page. It's a single line of JavaScript.
chatbot.step2Desc: Choose your brand colors, widget position, and set a custom greeting message.
chatbot.step3Desc: Upload documents about your services, FAQs, and policies. The AI learns from your content.
chatbot.step4Desc: Paste the code on your website. The chatbot starts helping visitors immediately.
chatbot.useCasesSubtitle: See how businesses use the chatbot widget
chatbot.perfectFor: Perfect for: E-commerce, Service providers, Consultants, Agencies
chatbot.useCase1Desc: Visitors browsing at 2am can book appointments without waiting for business hours.
chatbot.useCase1Example: Reduces support emails by 60% with automated FAQ answers
chatbot.useCase2Desc: The AI asks qualifying questions and routes serious inquiries to your calendar.
chatbot.useCase2Example: Converts 3x more website visitors into bookings
chatbot.useCase3Desc: Answer common questions about pricing, availability, and services instantly.
chatbot.useCase3Example: Visitors get answers in seconds, not hours
chatbot.pricingSubtitle: The website chatbot is part of the AI Chatbot add-on
chatbot.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about the website chatbot
chatbot.faq1Q: Will it work on my website?
chatbot.faq1A: Yes! The chatbot works on any website - WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, custom sites, and more. Just paste the embed code.
chatbot.faq2Q: Does it slow down my website?
chatbot.faq2A: No. The widget loads asynchronously and has minimal impact on page speed. It's optimized for performance.
chatbot.faq3Q: Can I control what the AI says?
chatbot.faq3A: Yes! The AI uses your knowledge base documents to answer questions. You control the information it has access to.
chatbot.faq4Q: What if the AI can't answer a question?
chatbot.faq4A: The AI will politely acknowledge it doesn't know and suggest the visitor contact you directly. You can also set up escalation rules.
chatbot.faq5Q: Can visitors book without creating an account?
chatbot.faq5A: Yes! Visitors can book as guests. They just need to provide their name and email to complete the booking.
chatbot.finalCtaTitle: Ready to Add AI to Your Website?
chatbot.finalCtaSubtitle: Start converting more visitors into customers today

aboutPage.metaDescription: Learn about BookBot's mission to help service businesses automate their booking and customer support.
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: On a mission to help service businesses save time and delight customers
aboutPage.storyP1: BookBot was born from a simple frustration: watching small business owners spend hours on the phone scheduling appointments instead of doing what they love.
aboutPage.storyP2: We saw hair stylists interrupt haircuts to answer calls. Doctors running behind because of no-shows. Personal trainers spending evenings managing bookings instead of training clients.
aboutPage.storyP3: We built BookBot to solve this. An AI-powered booking system that handles the scheduling, sends the reminders, and answers customer questions - so business owners can focus on their craft.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Powerful features shouldn't mean complex setup. If it takes more than 5 minutes to get started, we've failed.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Your AI assistant speaks your language, knows your services, and represents your brand. Not ours.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Enterprise software shouldn't be required to compete. We make professional tools accessible to everyone.
aboutPage.value4Desc: Your customers don't wait for business hours. Neither should your booking system.

privacy.metaDescription: Learn how BookBot collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: At BookBot, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our booking platform.
privacy.collectText: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, and business details when you create an account. We also collect usage data to improve our services.
privacy.useText: We use your information to provide our booking services, send appointment reminders, improve our platform, and communicate with you about your account.
privacy.shareText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who help us operate BookBot, but only as necessary to provide our services.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit and at rest, secure servers, and regular security audits.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can manage your preferences in your account settings or contact us for assistance.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at privacy@bookbot.app.
